title: Kissed Juicy Japanese Tofu Agedashi
description: Salty, juicy, and comforting, this diabetic-friendly Japanese dish features crispy fried tofu in a savory beurre noisette sauce, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat to 350 degrees
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and cornstarch
Toss the tofu cubes in the flour mixture to coat, shaking off excess
Fry the tofu cubes in the hot oil until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried tofu from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat until it turns golden brown and smells nutty
Add the soy sauce and dashi broth to the beurre noisette and whisk until smooth
To serve, place the fried tofu cubes in a bowl and spoon the beurre noisette sauce over the top
Garnish with thinly sliced scallions and a piece of binchotan charcoal on the side, if desired
